# Format and integer conversions ("Format conversions", "Integer
# conversions"). Widen is exact. Narrow has preferred exponent Q(x).
# Int64To64 and Uint64To64 round with preferred exponent 0; the decimal128
# forms are exact. The From conversions round to an integer in the mode
# and report Exact, Inexact, Inexact|Overflow (saturated) or Invalid.

# --- Widen ---

Widen - exact 1.50 -> 1.50
Widen - exact 1.0E+370 -> 1.0E+370
Widen - exact 9.999999999999999E+384 -> 9.999999999999999E+384
Widen - exact 1234567890123456 -> 1234567890123456
Widen - exact 0.000001 -> 0.000001
Widen - exact -1E+369 -> -1E+369
Widen - exact 9007199254740992 -> 9007199254740992
Widen - exact 1E+16 -> 1E+16

Widen - underflow 0E-398 -> 0E-398
Widen - underflow 1E-398 -> 1E-398
Widen - underflow 9.99999999999999E-384 -> 9.99999999999999E-384
Widen - underflow -1E-398 -> -1E-398

Widen - zero -0 -> -0
Widen - zero 0 -> 0
Widen - zero -0E+369 -> -0E+369
Widen - zero 0.00 -> 0.00

Widen - inf Infinity -> Infinity
Widen - inf -Infinity -> -Infinity

Widen - nan NaN -> NaN
Widen - nan sNaN -> NaN
Widen - nan -NaN -> NaN
Widen - nan -sNaN -> NaN
Widen - nan 0x7c00000000000001 -> NaN
Widen - nan 0xfe0000000001e240 -> NaN

Widen - noncanon 0x6c77ffffffffffff -> 0
Widen - noncanon 0xec9fffffffffffff -> -0E+5
Widen - noncanon 0x6c7386f26fc10000 -> 0
Widen - noncanon 0x6007ffffffffffff -> 0E-398
Widen - noncanon 0x77ffffffffffffff -> 0E+369
Widen - noncanon 0x7c038d7ea4c68000 -> NaN

# --- Narrow ---

Narrow even exact 1.50 -> 1.50
Narrow even exact 1E-398 -> 1E-398
Narrow even exact 1.23456789E-390 -> 1.23456789E-390
Narrow even exact 1234567890123456 -> 1234567890123456
Narrow even exact 9.999999999999999E+384 -> 9.999999999999999E+384
Narrow even exact 1E+369 -> 1E+369
Narrow even exact 123E+368 -> 1.23E+370
Narrow up exact 1.50 -> 1.50
Narrow even exact 1.000000000000000E+16 -> 1.000000000000000E+16

Narrow even inexact 0.3333333333333333333333333333333333 -> 0.3333333333333333
Narrow up inexact 0.3333333333333333333333333333333333 -> 0.3333333333333334
